```{r}
#| label: setup-candidate-products
#| include: false

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Instale el paquete 'pacman' antes de renderizar esta página.", call. = FALSE)
}
library(pacman)
p_load(
  tidyverse,
  readxl,
  janitor,
  arrow,
  reactable,
  plotly,
  glue,
  scales
)

source("r/00_config.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
source("r/02_functions_plots.R", encoding = "UTF-8")

# Productos en evaluación. La columna evaluation_hc_cat2 explicita la categoría
# contra la que se quiere medir el peso potencial del producto. Si el equipo
# decide evaluar un producto contra otra categoría, basta con modificar esta
# tabla dentro del QMD.
candidate_products <- tibble::tribble(
  ~product, ~description, ~evaluation_hc_cat2, ~evaluation_note,
  "382100",
  "Prepared culture media for the development or maintenance of micro-organisms (including viruses and the like) or of plant, human or animal cells.",
  "Dispositivos de diagnóstico in vitro y de laboratorio",
  "Asignación preliminar: insumo/medio de cultivo usado en entornos de laboratorio; revisar si corresponde mantenerlo fuera del universo de dispositivos.",
  "901110",
  "Microscopes, compound optical: stereoscopic microscopes.",
  "Equipos de laboratorio",
  "Asignación preliminar: equipo de laboratorio de uso potencialmente sanitario, aunque el código no distingue uso final médico.",
  "901120",
  "Microscopes, compound optical: for photomicrography, cinephotomicrography or microprojection.",
  "Equipos de laboratorio",
  "Asignación preliminar: equipo de laboratorio de uso potencialmente sanitario, aunque el código no distingue uso final médico.",
  "902219",
  "Apparatus based on the use of x-rays, including radiography or radiotherapy apparatus: for other than medical, surgical, dental or veterinary uses.",
  "Dispositivos de diagnóstico por imagen",
  "Código explícitamente definido para usos distintos de los médicos, quirúrgicos, dentales o veterinarios; se incluye sólo para evaluar su peso potencial."
)

exports_region <- load_dashboard_data(
  "exports_region_hc_cat2.rds",
  data_dir = "data/dashboard"
)

trade_balance <- load_dashboard_data(
  "trade_balance_lac.rds",
  data_dir = "data/dashboard"
)

product_catalog_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  "data/rev_paho_2026.xlsx",
  sheet = "exportable"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

product_code_col <- intersect(c("code", "product"), names(product_catalog_raw))
if (length(product_code_col) == 0) {
  stop("No se encontró una columna de código de producto en data/rev_paho_2026.xlsx.", call. = FALSE)
}
product_code_col <- product_code_col[[1]]

product_catalog <- product_catalog_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    product = as.character(.data[[product_code_col]]),
    hc = as.integer(hc),
    current_hc_cat2 = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$hc == 1L,
      as.character(hc_cat2),
      NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(product, dplyr::desc(.data$hc == 1L)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(product, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(product, hc, current_hc_cat2)

candidate_products <- candidate_products |>
  dplyr::left_join(product_catalog, by = "product") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    current_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$current_hc_cat2) & .data$current_hc_cat2 == .data$evaluation_hc_cat2 ~
        "Ya incluida en la categoría de evaluación",
      !is.na(.data$current_hc_cat2) ~
        "Incluida actualmente en otra categoría",
      !is.na(.data$hc) ~
        "Presente en la hoja exportable, pero no activa como producto de salud",
      TRUE ~ "No incluida actualmente en la clasificación"
    ),
    candidate_is_new_for_category = is.na(.data$current_hc_cat2) |
      .data$current_hc_cat2 != .data$evaluation_hc_cat2,
    current_hc_cat2 = tidyr::replace_na(
      .data$current_hc_cat2,
      "Sin categoría hc_cat2 activa"
    )
  )

candidate_product_codes <- candidate_products$product

# Clasificación de países equivalente a la usada en el script de procesamiento.
# Se replica aquí para que esta página sea autocontenida y no obligue a crear
# una nueva base liviana sólo para esta decisión metodológica puntual.
countries <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/raw/country_codes_V202601.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    readxl::read_excel("data/country-class.xlsx") |>
      janitor::clean_names(),
    by = c("country_iso3" = "code")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    country_code = as.integer(country_code),
    region = dplyr::case_when(
      region == "Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan" ~ "MENA",
      region == "Latin America & Caribbean" ~ "LAC",
      region == "East Asia & Pacific" ~ "Asia oriental y el Pacífico",
      region == "Central Asia" ~ "Asia central",
      region == "Europe" ~ "Europa",
      region == "North America" ~ "América del Norte",
      region == "South Asia" ~ "Asia meridional",
      region == "Sub-Saharan Africa" ~ "África al sur del Sahara",
      TRUE ~ unclassified_region
    ),
    region = dplyr::if_else(
      country_code == 490L,
      "Asia oriental y el Pacífico",
      region
    ),
    region = dplyr::if_else(
      country_code %in% c(533L, 531L, 796L, 92L, 534L),
      unclassified_region,
      region
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(country_code, country_name, region)

countries_exp <- countries |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("exp_", .), -country_code)
countries_imp <- countries |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("imp_", .), -country_code)

candidate_trade <- arrow::open_dataset("data/raw/parquet") |>
  dplyr::mutate(product = as.character(product)) |>
  dplyr::filter(product %in% .env$candidate_product_codes) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::left_join(countries_exp, by = c("exporter" = "country_code")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(countries_imp, by = c("importer" = "country_code")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    exp_region = tidyr::replace_na(as.character(exp_region), unclassified_region),
    imp_region = tidyr::replace_na(as.character(imp_region), unclassified_region)
  )

if (nrow(candidate_trade) == 0) {
  stop("No se encontraron flujos BACI para los productos candidatos.", call. = FALSE)
}

common_years <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    unique(candidate_trade$year),
    unique(exports_region$year),
    unique(trade_balance$year)
  )
)
latest_year <- max(common_years, na.rm = TRUE)

category_world_totals <- exports_region |>
  dplyr::group_by(year, evaluation_hc_cat2 = hc_cat2) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    category_world_exports_1000usd = sum(exports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_lac_totals <- trade_balance |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$ref_area_code == "LAC",
    .data$ref_area_type == "region"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(year, evaluation_hc_cat2 = hc_cat2) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    category_lac_exports_1000usd = sum(exports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    category_lac_imports_1000usd = sum(imports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_totals <- category_world_totals |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    category_lac_totals,
    by = c("year", "evaluation_hc_cat2")
  )

candidate_by_product <- candidate_trade |>
  dplyr::group_by(year, product) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    candidate_world_exports_1000usd = sum(value_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    candidate_lac_exports_1000usd = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(exp_region == "LAC", value_1000usd, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    candidate_lac_imports_1000usd = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(imp_region == "LAC", value_1000usd, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(candidate_products, by = "product") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    category_totals,
    by = c("year", "evaluation_hc_cat2")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    world_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_world_exports_1000usd +
      dplyr::if_else(
        candidate_is_new_for_category,
        candidate_world_exports_1000usd,
        0
      ),
    lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_lac_exports_1000usd +
      dplyr::if_else(
        candidate_is_new_for_category,
        candidate_lac_exports_1000usd,
        0
      ),
    lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_lac_imports_1000usd +
      dplyr::if_else(
        candidate_is_new_for_category,
        candidate_lac_imports_1000usd,
        0
      ),
    share_world_exports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      world_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_world_exports_1000usd / world_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    ),
    share_lac_exports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_lac_exports_1000usd / lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    ),
    share_lac_imports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_lac_imports_1000usd / lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

candidate_by_category <- candidate_by_product |>
  dplyr::group_by(year, evaluation_hc_cat2) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    candidate_products = paste(product, collapse = ", "),
    n_products = dplyr::n_distinct(product),
    candidate_world_exports_1000usd = sum(candidate_world_exports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    candidate_lac_exports_1000usd = sum(candidate_lac_exports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    candidate_lac_imports_1000usd = sum(candidate_lac_imports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    candidate_world_exports_to_add_1000usd = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(candidate_is_new_for_category, candidate_world_exports_1000usd, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    candidate_lac_exports_to_add_1000usd = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(candidate_is_new_for_category, candidate_lac_exports_1000usd, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    candidate_lac_imports_to_add_1000usd = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(candidate_is_new_for_category, candidate_lac_imports_1000usd, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    category_world_exports_1000usd = dplyr::first(category_world_exports_1000usd),
    category_lac_exports_1000usd = dplyr::first(category_lac_exports_1000usd),
    category_lac_imports_1000usd = dplyr::first(category_lac_imports_1000usd),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    world_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_world_exports_1000usd +
      candidate_world_exports_to_add_1000usd,
    lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_lac_exports_1000usd +
      candidate_lac_exports_to_add_1000usd,
    lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd = category_lac_imports_1000usd +
      candidate_lac_imports_to_add_1000usd,
    share_world_exports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      world_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_world_exports_1000usd / world_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    ),
    share_lac_exports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_lac_exports_1000usd / lac_exports_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    ),
    share_lac_imports_if_included = dplyr::if_else(
      lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd > 0,
      candidate_lac_imports_1000usd / lac_imports_denominator_if_included_1000usd,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

candidate_latest <- candidate_by_product |>
  dplyr::filter(year == latest_year)

category_latest <- candidate_by_category |>
  dplyr::filter(year == latest_year)

format_usd_musd_plain <- function(x) {
  scales::label_number(
    accuracy = 0.1,
    big.mark = ".",
    decimal.mark = ","
  )(x / 1000)
}

render_candidate_product_table <- function(data) {
  table_data <- data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      producto = product,
      descripcion = description,
      categoria_evaluacion = evaluation_hc_cat2,
      exportaciones_mundo_musd = candidate_world_exports_1000usd / 1000,
      peso_exportaciones_mundo = share_world_exports_if_included,
      exportaciones_lac_musd = candidate_lac_exports_1000usd / 1000,
      peso_exportaciones_lac = share_lac_exports_if_included,
      importaciones_lac_musd = candidate_lac_imports_1000usd / 1000,
      peso_importaciones_lac = share_lac_imports_if_included
    )

  reactable::reactable(
    table_data,
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 4,
    columns = list(
      producto = reactable::colDef(name = "HS07"),
      descripcion = reactable::colDef(name = "Descripción", minWidth = 300),
      categoria_evaluacion = reactable::colDef(name = "Categoría de evaluación", minWidth = 260),
      exportaciones_mundo_musd = reactable::colDef(
        name = "Exp. mundiales, USD millones",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 1, separators = TRUE)
      ),
      peso_exportaciones_mundo = reactable::colDef(
        name = "% de exp. mundiales de la categoría",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 2)
      ),
      exportaciones_lac_musd = reactable::colDef(
        name = "Exp. LAC, USD millones",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 1, separators = TRUE)
      ),
      peso_exportaciones_lac = reactable::colDef(
        name = "% de exp. LAC de la categoría",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 2)
      ),
      importaciones_lac_musd = reactable::colDef(
        name = "Imp. LAC, USD millones",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 1, separators = TRUE)
      ),
      peso_importaciones_lac = reactable::colDef(
        name = "% de imp. LAC de la categoría",
        align = "right",
        format = reactable::colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 2)
      )
    )
  )
}

share_plot_data <- category_latest |>
  dplyr::select(
    evaluation_hc_cat2,
    share_world_exports_if_included,
    share_lac_exports_if_included,
    share_lac_imports_if_included
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("share_"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "share"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = dplyr::recode(
      metric,
      share_world_exports_if_included = "Exp. mundiales",
      share_lac_exports_if_included = "Exp. LAC",
      share_lac_imports_if_included = "Imp. LAC"
    ),
    tooltip = make_tooltip(
      glue::glue("<b>Categoría:</b> {evaluation_hc_cat2}"),
      glue::glue("<b>Indicador:</b> {metric}"),
      glue::glue("<b>Peso estimado:</b> {format_percent_label(share, accuracy = 0.01)}")
    )
  )
```

Esta página auxiliar estima cuánto pesarían cuatro productos candidatos en las estadísticas del dashboard si se incorporaran a las categorías indicadas abajo.

## Productos evaluados

```{r}
#| label: candidate-product-table

render_candidate_product_table(candidate_latest)
```


## Comparación visual

```{r}
#| label: candidate-share-plot
#| fig-height: 5.6

p <- share_plot_data |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = share,
      y = forcats::fct_reorder(evaluation_hc_cat2, share, .fun = max),
      fill = metric,
      text = tooltip
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1, decimal.mark = ","),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Exp. mundiales" = "#4C78A8",
      "Exp. LAC" = "#1B9E77",
      "Imp. LAC" = "#D95F02"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = glue::glue("Peso estimado de productos candidatos, {latest_year}"),
    subtitle = "Participación en el total de la categoría de evaluación",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_trade()

plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  center_plotly_title(
    title = glue::glue("Peso estimado de productos candidatos, {latest_year}"),
    subtitle = "Participación en el total de la categoría de evaluación"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.2))
```
